data.case_title: Bauspar Beispielheim – Proof of loan use required
data.title: Proof of loan use required for building loan payout
data.summary: Bauspar Beispielheim AG writes that before they can pay out Bastian Musterquell's building savings loan (Bauspardarlehen), they need proof that the money is being used for his apartment, either the heating company's invoice or the signed order. The proof must be submitted within 10 business days of the letter's date.
data.explanation: Your Bausparkasse needs evidence that the loan money is going toward your home, such as the heating company's invoice or the signed order, before they release the payout. Send this document to them by the deadline shown in the app. If you miss it, the payout will simply be postponed to the next first of the month rather than cancelled, but acting promptly avoids the delay. Keep a copy of whatever you send for your own records.

items.title: Submit proof that the loan is used for your apartment
items.action: Send Bauspar Beispielheim AG the heating company's invoice or the signed order showing the loan money is being used for your home.
items.consequence: If the proof does not arrive in time, the payout of the building loan will be postponed to the next first of the month.
